title: Tailscale policy file
description: Hand-maintained schema for Tailscale HuJSON policy files, tracking the fields the Headscale hscontrol/policy/v2 compiler accepts plus the Tailscale syntax reference. Kept in sync by engine/schema/sync_test.go.

groups.description: Named collections of users. Group names must start with 'group:'.

hosts.description: Named IP addresses or CIDR ranges, usable anywhere an alias is accepted.

tagOwners.description: Which users or groups may assign each tag. Tag names must start with 'tag:'.

acls.description: Access-control rules. Each rule allows traffic from every src to every dst.

grants.description: The newer, more expressive form of access rule. Carries IP/port capabilities and/or application capabilities.

nodeAttrs.description: Attach node capabilities to the devices selected by target.

autoApprovers.description: Routes and exit nodes that are approved automatically when advertised by an owner.

ssh.description: Tailscale SSH rules: who may SSH into which devices, as which local users.

tests.description: Self-checks run against the compiled policy: assert reachability from a source.

sshTests.description: Self-checks for SSH rules: assert which users may SSH from a source to each dst.

randomizeClientPort.description: Ask clients to use a random source port instead of the default 41641.

disableIPv4.description: Stop assigning Tailscale IPv4 addresses. No effect on policy evaluation — Tailground ignores it (info note).

oneCGNATRoute.description: Control whether clients install one 100.64.0.0/10 route or fine-grained routes. No effect on policy evaluation — Tailground ignores it (info note).

derpMap.description: Custom DERP relay servers. No effect on policy evaluation — Tailground ignores it (info note).

extraDNSRecords.description: Extra DNS records served to the tailnet. No effect on policy evaluation — Tailground ignores it (info note).

postures.description: Named device-posture definitions. Tailground evaluates these itself (its own reading of the syntax); the Headscale engine ignores them.

additionalProperties.description: Conditions, all of which must hold. e.g. "node:os == 'macos'", "node:tsVersion >= '1.80'", "custom:env == 'prod'", "custom:riskScore < '50'".

defaultSrcPosture.description: Baseline posture names applied to every acls/grants/ssh rule that has no srcPosture of its own. A rule's own srcPosture replaces (does not combine with) this default. Applied by Tailground's posture layer; stripped before compile with an info note.

attrConfig.description: Declares custom device-posture attributes referenced by postures as custom:<name>. Schema per the official client (tailscale/tailscale-client-go-v2#29, tailscale/tailscale#16167); not in Tailscale's public policy reference. Tailground uses the declared type to pick string vs. numeric comparison; per-device values come from the snapshot (device posture). Stripped before compile with an info note.

type.description: How the attribute's value is compared. Real values are string / bool / number; boolean and integer are tolerated aliases. Defaults to string.

allowSetByNode.description: Whether a node may set this attribute on itself via LocalAPI. Not modeled by Tailground (write control, not evaluation).

broadcastToPeers.description: Destinations that receive this attribute's value (e.g. ["tag:admin"], ["*"]); absent means it is not broadcast. Not modeled by Tailground (propagation, not evaluation).

postureIntegrations.description: External device-posture providers (Intune, Jamf, Kandji, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, …). Not modeled — Tailground evaluates only the built-in node:os / node:tsVersion / node:tsReleaseTrack conditions, so a srcPosture condition on a custom attribute these would supply will not match (warning + stripped).

ipsets.description: Named collections of CIDRs, IPs, IP ranges, host: aliases and other ipset: references. Tailground expands ipset:<name> tokens to their prefixes before compiling; the Headscale engine has no ipset support.

externalTailnets.description: Declarative node sharing: other tailnets whose nodes are shared into this one, keyed by a local alias used in group://<alias>/<name> and tag://<alias>/<name> tokens. Tailground resolves those tokens against the shared nodes in the snapshot before compiling; the Headscale engine has no cross-tailnet concept. The wire syntax is not in Tailscale's public policy reference — this shape is Tailground's interpretation.

externalID.description: The external tailnet's identifier. Required: Tailscale rejects an entry without one ("missing externalTailnet ID").

allowIncomingConnections.description: Allow this tailnet's shared nodes to initiate connections into this tailnet, i.e. appear in a grant's src. Without it, Tailscale rejects any grant whose src references this tailnet ("external tailnet not allowed in local policy grants").

allowExternalReferencesTo.description: Local groups/tags this tailnet's own policy may reference. Tailground validates and echoes this but gates nothing on it (the other policy isn't visible).

alias.description: A user email, user:*@<domain> membership wildcard, group:*, tag:*, host name, CIDR, ipset:*, svc:* (destination only), group://<tailnet>/<name>, tag://<tailnet>/<name>, '*', or autogroup:* token. The admin-role autogroups (autogroup:admin / owner / auditor / it-admin / network-admin / billing-admin) and autogroup:shared are resolved by Tailground against each snapshot user's role before compilation. A svc:<name> destination is rewritten to the service VIP from the snapshot before compilation (the Headscale engine has no Tailscale Services). A group:// / tag:// reference is only valid in a grant's src (Tailscale rejects it anywhere else) and is resolved against the externalTailnets shared nodes in the snapshot before compilation.

action.description: Only 'accept' is supported; there is no explicit deny.

proto.description: Restrict the rule to one protocol. Omit for TCP+UDP+ICMP.

srcPosture.description: Posture names (any of which the source device must satisfy). Evaluated by Tailground's posture layer.

dst.description: Destinations in host:port form (port may be a range, list, or '*').

srcPosture.description: Posture names (any of which the source device must satisfy). Evaluated by Tailground's posture layer.

app.description: Application capabilities: capability name -> array of JSON argument objects.

via.description: Route the grant through the listed tagged gateway devices.

app.description: Application-layer node capabilities (e.g. tailscale.com/app-connectors). Tailground surfaces these on the target devices' capabilities; app-connector routing itself is not simulated.

ipPool.description: Preferred IP pool(s) for the target devices (parsed, not yet enforced).

routes.description: CIDR -> list of users/groups/tags allowed to auto-approve that route.

exitNode.description: Users/groups/tags whose advertised exit nodes are auto-approved.

action.description: 'accept' connects directly; 'check' requires periodic browser re-auth.

src.description: Users, groups, tags or autogroups allowed to connect.

srcPosture.description: Posture names the source must satisfy. Evaluated by Tailground's posture layer, in order, with a miss falling through to the next ssh rule.

dst.description: Destination devices (tags, autogroup:self, or user for user-owned devices).

users.description: Local login names allowed, 'localpart:*@<domain>' (log in as the local-part of your own email), 'autogroup:nonroot', or '*'.

checkPeriod.description: How long a 'check' auth lasts, e.g. '12h', or 'always' to check every time.

acceptEnv.description: Environment variable names (glob patterns allowed) the client may forward.

recorder.description: Session-recorder nodes (Tailscale SSH session recording, an Enterprise feature). Tailground does not model session recording — this key is stripped with an info note and the rule still evaluates for reachability.

enforceRecorder.description: Reject the SSH session if no recorder is reachable. Stripped by Tailground (session recording is not modeled).

proto.description: Restrict the assertion to one protocol.

accept.description: host:port destinations that must be reachable from src.

deny.description: host:port destinations that must NOT be reachable from src.

dst.description: Destinations the assertion exercises (tag, host, or SSH autogroup).

accept.description: Login names that must reach every dst via an accept- or check-action rule.

deny.description: Login names that must NOT reach any dst.

check.description: Login names that must reach every dst via a check-action rule specifically.
